fields.Name: T371 - Form Builder Versions Panel And Diff
fields.Description: Exercises the version rail (fb-versions-list rows + activate/restore) and the side-by-side diff dialog (OnVersionDiffClick → fb-diff-modal) — Form Builder version-control UI unique to this surface.

InputDefinition.goal: In Component Studio → Form Studio, open an existing form in the left rail. Below the forms list, verify the 'Versions' panel renders showing version rows (v1, v2, …) with Active/Pending/Inactive tags — or a 'No version history yet' empty state if the form has none. If two or more versions exist, click the diff (code-compare) icon on one version row, then on another, to open the 'Compare versions' dialog showing side-by-side A/B code panes. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the versions panel render (and, when 2+ versions exist, the diff dialog open) is success. A clean 'no version history' empty state is also a pass.

judgeValidationCriteria: Opening a form shows a 'Versions' panel with version rows (with Active/Pending/Inactive tags) or a clear 'No version history yet' empty state
When multiple versions exist, initiating a diff opens a 'Compare versions' dialog with two side-by-side code panes
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
